description:
What changed in the series the user has alerts on: new periods and revisions, oldest first. Use it to answer "what changed since my last check" without webhooks.
First call: no arguments (the last 7 days) or since (an ISO date). Keep next_cursor and pass it as cursor next time to get only newer changes. has_more says another page is waiting.
Example: {"cursor": "1842"}. Returns {changes: [{id, cursor, type: "new_period" | "revision", created_at, indicator, place, frequency, period_count, first_period, last_period, changes: [{period, value, status?, previous_value?, previous_status?}], source: {id, name, publisher, url}, links: {page, api}, alerts}], next_cursor, has_more}.
Cite source.url and the period when reporting a change. Changes are kept 35 days.

alert.description: Optional alert id: only changes matched to this alert.

since.description: ISO date or time for a first call, for example "2026-10-01". Ignored when cursor is set.

name: list_changes
title: List changes to alerted series
